title: Image Ripple
summary: Three continuous wavefronts bend light from the image center to its edges, using radial displacement and soft crest-and-trough shading.

blocks.content:
This study turns one photograph into a center-out water ripple while keeping the original image perfectly still and undistorted beneath the effect.

Three phase-offset wavefronts travel continuously beyond the frame. A lightweight GPU shader bends pixels in opposite directions around each crest, then adds a soft highlight and trough shadow so the edge reads as curved water rather than a circular crop.
When reduced motion is enabled, the animation pauses on a composed still frame while preserving the layered refraction.
